Subject: Request for complete data erasure under DPDPA
Email_Content_Body: I want to delete my account and all associated personal data from your systems immediately.
Expected_Agent_Behavior: Acknowledge request, cite privacy policy rights, and route to DPB compliance workflow.

Subject: Where is my delayed order? Force Majeure check
Email_Content_Body: My order has been stuck at the hub for 10 days due to local strikes. I want a refund now.
Expected_Agent_Behavior: Explain force majeure shipping tiers, check current courier status, and decline premature refund.

Subject: Return request missing photo evidence
Email_Content_Body: Returning this gaming keyboard because one of the keys is stuck and unresponsive. Here is the original packaging.
Expected_Agent_Behavior: Request mandatory photo evidence per return policy before initiating replacement workflow.

Subject: Refund amount incorrect after COD cancellation
Email_Content_Body: I cancelled my order while it was out for delivery. Why is my Rs.100 COD fee not refunded?
Expected_Agent_Behavior: Confirm policy mandates full refund including COD charge; correct refund calculation.

Subject: Price drop refund request post-sale
Email_Content_Body: The item I bought yesterday is now 20% cheaper on your site. Please refund the difference.
Expected_Agent_Behavior: Politely decline per promotional-sale rules disallowing price-difference refunds.

Subject: Threat to file case in Consumer Forum (NCH)
Email_Content_Body: Unresolved issue for 40 days. Escalating to National Consumer Helpline and e-Daakhil.
Expected_Agent_Behavior: Escalate immediately to Grievance Officer, bypassing tier-1 support templates.
